title: setup instructions --help and -h print the usage with its flags, and setup --help lists it
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). `jitso setup instructions --help` (and `-h`) print the usage of the setup group on stdout, with the `instructions` line, `--scope`, `--remove`, `--dry-run` and `--yes` documented, exit 0, empty stderr, nothing written. `jitso setup --help` lists it too.

stdout: --remove  remove the block; the rest of each file stays byte for byte
